title: Twitch CEO Predicts GTA 6 Online Next Year Amid Rockstar Silence
description: Rockstar remains tight-lipped on GTA 6 Online, but Twitch's CEO reckons it will launch next year, while the base game arrives on November 19 with a single-player campaign only.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Silence Surrounding GTA 6 Online

As the highly anticipated launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 draws closer, excitement among gamers worldwide continues to reach unprecedented levels. However, developer Rockstar Games has remained remarkably tight-lipped regarding the game's multiplayer component—the potential successor to Grand Theft Auto 5's immensely popular GTA Online. To date, the studio has not even officially confirmed whether a multiplayer mode will launch.

All official information currently confirms that when Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives on November 19, it will launch strictly with the single-player campaign. This measured approach to sharing information has left fans and industry watchers to speculate on when and how the inevitable online experience might materialize.

## Twitch CEO's Forecast Sparks Discussion

In the absence of official statements from Rockstar, Twitch's CEO has offered a prediction regarding the game's online future, stating that he reckons the multiplayer mode will land next year. This commentary has naturally generated significant discussion across gaming media and community forums, given the platform leader's unique vantage point within the gaming ecosystem.

It is important to emphasize, however, that this remark is an outside prediction rather than a confirmed announcement. Rockstar Games has not verified this timeline, maintaining its strict policy of withholding details about post-launch online infrastructure.

## Looking Back at Past Precedents

Industry observers often look back at Rockstar's previous major release, Grand Theft Auto 5, which debuted a decade ago with a similar strategy of separating the single-player experience from its online counterpart. Given the monumental, long-term success of GTA Online, many analysts consider a future multiplayer rollout for GTA 6 to be an industry expectation, even if the developer itself refuses to rush its announcements.

For now, players must keep expectations grounded in the confirmed facts: the single-player campaign launches on November 19, and any details concerning the online component remain unconfirmed by the developer.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's quiet strategy with GTA 6 keeps the anticipation palpable. While the Twitch CEO's prediction of a multiplayer launch next year sounds plausible given past industry patterns, players should treat it strictly as speculation until Rockstar decides to share its official roadmap.
